support_classes.doc: Loads src/test/resources/config.properties once and exposes typed accessors.
ThreadLocal WebDriver factory. Keeping the driver ThreadLocal lets tests run in parallel later (TestNG parallel="methods") without sharing browser state.
Expected drug data captured manually from the live MyPrime site for a given health plan + drug list, used as the oracle for coverage assertions. See src/test/resources/testdata/expected-drugs.json.
Shared driver/wait plumbing for every page object. Keeping locators and flows in the concrete page classes; this only holds reusable actions.
One shared ExtentReports instance for the whole suite, with a per-thread "current test" node so parallel TestNG execution doesn't cross-log.

Bridges TestNG's test lifecycle to an ExtentReports HTML report: one ExtentTest node per @Test method, with the failure screenshot BaseTest would otherwise only save to disk also embedded inline in the report.
